comparison.scope: 480 chat operations on four isolated reduced synthetic SQLite working-set databases. Each calibration/later snapshot captured once and reused for both modes. Baseline restores original candidate method in this probe process only; optimized uses current method. Remaining source identical, including trivial allocation of unused ref set in baseline. 20 warmup + 100 measured per mode/state. Source databases read-only; no external services. Shared warmed host, sequential baseline/optimized order and instrumentation overhead. Archival table-size costs excluded. Nested timings overlap; CPU process-wide includes GC helpers. No original full-run throughput claim.
